AppState.title: AppState
AppState.description: The complete global state of the WM2 Produções platform, containing all information about classes (turmas), students, financial status, events, polls, and media uploads.

formandos.description: List of all active and pending students (Formandos)

enquetes.description: List of opinion polls and surveys (Enquetes)

fotos.description: List of uploaded photographs in the shared media gallery (Fotos)

mural.description: List of messages and announcements posted on the community wall (Mural)

fornecedores.description: List of linked vendors, caterers, security, and event suppliers (Fornecedores)

reunioes.description: List of scheduled meetings between administrators and graduation committees

theme.description: User interface color theme preference ('light' or 'dark') for the Admin Panel and platform.

/app_state/{docId}.description: The document path housing the real-time application database snapshot (usually 'app_state/current').
